description: Sales scheduling environment for handling a customer reschedule request. Contains the inbound reschedule email, the existing Calendly booking, the rep's calendar availability, lead record, and the reschedule policy. The system should validate a conflict-free slot and prepare a reschedule plan for the user's approval, without actually canceling/rebooking the meeting or writing to the CRM.

reschedule_policy.content: BrightPath Reschedule Policy: (1) Honor invitee timezone and stated preferences. (2) Offer the earliest available slot within 7 business days that has no calendar conflict and respects PTO/blocked time. (3) Leave at least 15 min buffer before and after the meeting. (4) Do not double-book the host. (5) Confirm the new time with the invitee before treating it as final. (6) Log a CRM note and update Next Step only after the new booking is confirmed.
